conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Namaste, main Pooja Malhotra. Mera UPI ID kaise create karoon?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Pooja ji, main aapko process batata hoon. Kya aap apna account number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Aap hamare mobile app se UPI ID create kar sakti hain. Main aapko step-by-step guide SMS karta hoon. Aapko bank-linked mobile number chahiye hoga.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Haan, wohi number hai. Kitna time lagega?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Turant setup ho jayega jaise hi aap steps follow karengi. Koi aur madad?
